createDebateTopic.title: Post to Debate Now
createDebateTopic.description: A short, headline-length prompt for the public feed. Posted anonymously — nobody sees this was you unless they run into you in a Reveal Flow elsewhere.
createDebateTopic.helperText: Keep it concise — a headline people react to, not a paragraph.

examples.ageLimit: Should social media have an age limit?
examples.protectFeelings: Is it ever okay to lie to protect someone's feelings?

debateTopicDetail.retractDescription: This removes it from the public feed and its own page. Comments already posted stay recorded, but nobody will be able to read or add to this thread again.

debateTopicDetail.keepKindText: Keep it kind — genuine, productive debate, not a fight.
